A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optimum PWHT for F22/625 weld overlays is at 705~720 °C for 2~3 hours, with a cooling rate less than 20°C/h.

the PWHT conditions of 1100~1150 °C/4~8h are recommended for F22/625 weld overlays, as they can reduce the CGHAZ hardness and increase the hardness of the PGZ, which are beneficial to the resistance of HAC and SSC.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the hardness of the F22/625 fusion boundary region is not only a function of HJP, but also of the PWHT time and temperature.
PWHT can reduce the hardness of F22 CGHAZ but may increase the hardness of F625 PGZ, which is the most critical region in terms of SSC resistance.
the hardness of the PGZ is a function of the HJP, and the hardness peak in the PGZ is due to the precipitation of carbides and/or intermetallic phases.
